Name: Apples
Description: Apples offer a wonderful variety of flavours and textures, from crisp, tart varieties to exceptionally sweet fruits with delicate floral notes. Their juicy flesh makes them ideal for snacking, while their natural balance of sweetness and acidity suits both sweet and savoury dishes. Apples provide dietary fibre, vitamin C and beneficial plant compounds, including polyphenols.

Name: Pears
Description: Pears are prized for their delicate sweetness, fragrant aromas and juicy flesh, which can range from crisp and refreshing to soft and buttery when ripe. Different varieties offer subtle notes of honey, citrus and spice, making them a versatile choice for fresh eating and cooking. Pears are a good source of dietary fibre and also provide vitamin C and potassium.

Name: Bananas
Description: Bananas offer much more variety than their familiar sweet flavour might suggest. Different varieties range from creamy and mellow to firmer, starchier and more subtly flavoured, with some developing distinctive tropical notes when ripe. Bananas provide potassium, vitamin B6 and carbohydrates, making them a convenient source of energy.

Name: Citrus
Description: Citrus fruits offer an exciting spectrum of flavours, from the sweetness of oranges and mandarins to the sharp tang of lemons and limes. Their juicy flesh and fragrant oils bring refreshing aromas and vibrant flavours to both sweet and savoury dishes. Many citrus fruits are excellent sources of vitamin C and contain beneficial plant compounds, including flavonoids.

Name: Mangoes
Description: Mangoes are celebrated for their succulent flesh, fragrant aroma and rich, tropical sweetness. Different varieties offer a fascinating range of flavours, from honey-like sweetness and citrus notes to hints of peach and coconut. Rich in vitamins A and C, mangoes also provide dietary fibre and beneficial plant compounds.

Name: Melons
Description: Melons offer a refreshing range of flavours, from delicately sweet and floral to rich, honey-like and intensely aromatic. Their juicy flesh can be crisp or soft, with colours ranging from pale green to vibrant orange. With their high water content and naturally refreshing taste, melons are particularly enjoyable during warmer weather and provide nutrients such as vitamin C and potassium.

Name: Potatoes & Yams
Description: Potatoes and yams offer an impressive variety of flavours and textures, from fluffy and mild to dense, creamy and naturally sweet. Different varieties can have white, yellow, orange or purple flesh, bringing distinctive colours and characteristics to a wide range of dishes. Depending on the variety, they provide carbohydrates for energy, dietary fibre, potassium and vitamin C.

Name: Chilli’s & Peppers
Description: Chillies and peppers bring an exciting combination of heat, sweetness, fruitiness and aromatic complexity to cooking. Mild peppers can offer crisp, juicy flesh with sweet or grassy notes, while hot chillies range from gently warming to intensely fiery, sometimes with fruity, smoky or citrus-like flavours. They are excellent sources of vitamin C, while many hot varieties contain capsaicin, the compound responsible for their characteristic heat.

Name: Coconuts
Description: Coconuts offer several distinct eating experiences, from the light, refreshing sweetness of coconut water to the rich, creamy flesh of mature fruits. Young coconuts generally have softer flesh and more water, while mature coconuts develop firmer meat with a pronounced nutty flavour. Coconut water provides electrolytes such as potassium, while the flesh contains dietary fibre and fats, including medium-chain fatty acids.

Name: Dates
Description: Dates are naturally sweet fruits with rich caramel-like flavours and textures ranging from soft and sticky to firm and chewy. Some varieties have notes of honey, toffee or butterscotch, while others offer a more delicate sweetness. Their naturally occurring sugars make them an energy-rich snack, and they also provide dietary fibre, potassium and other minerals.

Name: Dragon Fruits
Description: Widely regarded as one of the most eye-catching and delicious tropical fruits, they are an excellent source of betacyanins and lycopene and are rich in vitamin C, dietary fibre, and potassium.

Name: Durians
Description: Durian is famous for its powerful aroma, creamy texture and remarkably complex flavour. Depending on the variety, its rich flesh can taste sweet and custard-like, with notes reminiscent of caramel, almonds, vanilla or tropical fruit. Beneath its spiky exterior lies a distinctive tropical delicacy that provides carbohydrates, dietary fibre, potassium and several B vitamins.

Name: Jackfruits
Description: Jackfruit is a versatile tropical fruit with very different characteristics depending on its ripeness. Mature jackfruit has golden-yellow flesh with a sweet, fragrant flavour often compared to a combination of pineapple, mango and banana, while unripe jackfruit has a mild taste and fibrous texture that readily absorbs other flavours. It provides vitamin C, dietary fibre and potassium, making it an interesting ingredient for both sweet and savoury dishes.

Name: Passion Fruits
Description: Passion fruits are known for their intensely fragrant aroma, juicy pulp and distinctive balance of sweetness and tangy acidity. Depending on the variety, their flavours can range from floral and tropical to sharply refreshing, with crunchy edible seeds adding texture. Passion fruits provide dietary fibre, vitamin C and beneficial plant compounds.

Name: Soursop
Description: Soursop is a distinctive tropical fruit with soft, creamy-white flesh and a refreshing combination of sweetness and acidity. Its complex flavour is often compared to a blend of pineapple, strawberry and citrus, making it particularly appealing to adventurous fruit lovers. Soursop provides vitamin C, dietary fibre and potassium.

Name: Luxury Fruits
Description: Discover premium fruits chosen for their exceptional flavours, beautiful appearance and distinctive characteristics. From intensely sweet and aromatic varieties to delicate, juicy fruits with complex flavour profiles, this collection offers something special for discerning fruit lovers. Many varieties provide valuable nutrients, including vitamins, minerals and antioxidants, making them an indulgent way to explore the diversity of fresh fruit.

Name: Flavours & Aromatics
Description: Explore fruits and ingredients with distinctive aromas and complex flavour profiles, ranging from intensely fragrant and floral to spicy, citrusy and earthy. These unusual ingredients can introduce new dimensions to cooking, drinks and desserts, whether used to enhance sweetness, add freshness or provide an aromatic contrast. Depending on the ingredients, they may also contribute vitamins, minerals and beneficial plant compounds.

Name: Sweet Fruits
Description: For those who love naturally sweet flavours, this collection brings together fruits ranging from delicate and honey-like to rich, tropical and intensely fragrant. Some offer soft, creamy flesh, while others provide a satisfying crunch or refreshing juiciness. Alongside their natural sweetness, these fruits can supply dietary fibre, vitamins, minerals and antioxidants, with nutritional content varying between varieties.

Name: Sour Fruits
Description: Sour fruits deliver lively flavours characterised by refreshing acidity, tanginess and sometimes a distinctive sharpness. Their tastes can range from gently tart and citrusy to intensely mouth-puckering, often balanced by natural sweetness and fragrant aromas. Many sour fruits provide vitamin C and other beneficial plant compounds, while their bold flavours make them excellent additions to drinks, sauces and desserts.

Name: Juices
Description: Fruit juices bring together the natural flavours and aromas of a wide variety of fruits, from sweet and mellow to sharp, tangy and intensely tropical. Depending on the fruit, they can offer refreshing citrus notes, fragrant floral characteristics or rich, concentrated sweetness. Juices can provide vitamins and minerals, although their fibre content is generally lower than that of whole fruit and their natural sugar content varies.

Name: Selection Boxes
Description: Our selection boxes bring together a variety of fruits, allowing you to experience different flavours, colours and textures in one purchase. Discover combinations ranging from familiar sweet favourites to tangy tropical varieties and unusual fruits with distinctive aromas. They are an excellent way to sample fruits you may not have tried before, explore new favourites and enjoy a broader range of nutrients from different varieties.

Name: Alkaline Fruits
Description: Alkaline diets have become very popular in recent years, gaining celebrity followers such as Victoria Beckham, Jennifer Aniston, and Gwyneth Paltrow, because eating alkaline foods is considered vital for maintaining pH balance in the body.

Name: Unique Fruits
Description: Discover extraordinary fruits with unusual appearances, surprising textures and flavours that go beyond the familiar. From intensely fragrant tropical varieties to fruits with contrasting sweet, sour, creamy or tangy characteristics, this collection is ideal for curious eaters looking to expand their horizons. Many offer distinctive combinations of vitamins, minerals, dietary fibre and beneficial plant compounds, alongside the excitement of discovering something new.

Name: Miscellaneous
Description: Explore a varied collection of products offering a range of flavours, textures and uses. From sweet and juicy treats to unusual ingredients with distinctive aromas, this category brings together interesting finds that sit outside our main collections. It's an opportunity to discover something unexpected and perhaps find a new favourite.

Name: Gifts
Description: Give the gift of exceptional flavour with a selection of fruits and fruit products suited to sharing and special occasions. From naturally sweet and fragrant tropical fruits to colourful assortments offering a variety of tastes and textures, these gifts provide a memorable experience for adventurous food lovers. They are a thoughtful way to introduce someone to unfamiliar fruits or share the enjoyment of discovering something new.

Name: Dried Fruits
Description: Dried fruits concentrate the natural sweetness and flavours of fresh fruit, creating distinctive textures that range from soft and chewy to firm and pleasantly dense. Depending on the variety, flavours can include caramel-like richness, tangy fruitiness or delicate floral notes. They are convenient for snacking and cooking, and often provide dietary fibre and minerals, although their natural sugar content is more concentrated than in fresh fruit.

Name: Favourites
Description: Explore a collection of popular fruits and products celebrated for their distinctive flavours and appeal. From sweet, juicy tropical favourites to tangy varieties and unusual discoveries, this category brings together products worth exploring for both new customers and experienced fruit enthusiasts. It's an ideal place to find inspiration, revisit familiar tastes and discover something different.

Name: Guavas
Description: Guavas are fragrant tropical fruits with flavours ranging from sweet and floral to pleasantly tangy, sometimes with notes of pear, strawberry or citrus. Their flesh varies in colour and texture between varieties, offering plenty to discover. Guavas are particularly rich in vitamin C and also provide dietary fibre and antioxidants.

Name: Grapes
Description: Grapes offer a diverse range of flavours, from crisp, refreshing varieties with a delicate sweetness to intensely sweet fruits with floral, muscat or berry-like notes. Their juicy flesh and naturally thin skins make them convenient for snacking, while differences in colour, texture and flavour offer plenty of variety. Grapes provide vitamin K and beneficial plant compounds, including polyphenols, particularly in darker-skinned varieties.

Name: Pineapples
Description: Pineapples are prized for their juicy golden flesh and distinctive balance of tropical sweetness and refreshing acidity. Depending on the variety and ripeness, their flavour can range from sharp and tangy to exceptionally sweet, with fragrant notes that make them equally enjoyable fresh or in cooking. Pineapples provide vitamin C and manganese and naturally contain bromelain, a group of enzymes that helps break down proteins.
